errors.text_span: Освен това, диаграмата визуализира тенденцията към растеж, съпроводена с кратковременен спад в средата на периода.
errors.evidence: This sentence provides a summary and interpretation of the overall trend ("тенденцията към растеж" - trend towards growth), which is explicitly forbidden by the prompt that requires describing only what is visually present without making interpretations or conclusions.
The list of Y-axis labels provided in the description is incomplete; it omits the final label, 23500, which is clearly visible at the top of the Y-axis.
The phrase "за да се възстанови" (in order to recover) implies purpose or cause, which is a form of interpretation that goes beyond objective visual description.
The value of the line in 2019 is visibly below the 23000 mark. A more accurate approximation would be around 22900. Stating it is 'около 23000' (around 23000) is a slight overestimation.
